purpose: Wave-5 combat-adjacent permanent tools that ironman guides treat as skilling infrastructure (Prayer AFK restore ladder, drop-cleaner upgrades, POP scrimshaw craft, BoG pocket QoL, resource-dungeon teleports, RC pouch craft, Ancient Summoning bind contracts). Not pure combat BiS. Complements wave4-critical-tools + slayer-toolbelt without re-emitting first-class siblings already in regional-skilling-unlocks.json.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. region_hints lists support pressure. required_regions + region_requirement_type=all_required only when every listed region is a hard gate. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global in region fields.
policy.duplicate_guard: Grep-confirmed ABSENT from data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json (550 ids). SKIP already-present checklist: forinthry:charming-imp, forinthry:herbicide, forinthry:seedicide-named, forinthry:gold-accumulator, forinthry:advanced-gold-accumulator, forinthry:gem-bag, forinthry:gem-bag-upgraded, misthalin:auto-screener, misthalin:plank-box, anachronia:orthen-furnace-core, cross-region:orthen-furnace-core-stack, cross-region:bonecrusher-necklace (stack only — individual demon-horn necklace was missing), tirannwn:grace-of-the-elves, morytania:attuned-ectoplasmator, multi-region:toolbelt-*-attach, forinthry:smithing-autoheater*, asgarnia:spring-cleaner, desert:scrimshaw-crafter (facility only). Combat-skip per brief: Dragon Rider amulet, blood necklace, Luck of the Dwarves, ring of vigour.
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent unlocks that change Prayer AFK, drop-cleaner QoL, POP Fletching craft, pocket skilling, resource-dungeon travel, RC inventory, or Ancient Summoning bind economy.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, token/bean costs, and effects only.
policy.rs3_terminology: RS3 has no fused 'bonecrusher necklace' craft item. DG prayer necklaces are twisted bird skull / split dragontooth / demon horn. Sacrifice scrimshaw base is Mimic/TH-family not POP scroll craft; superior upgrade uses Scrimshaw Crafter + ancient bones after DG token unlock.

activity_additions.name: Skilling scrimshaw craft package (Player-owned port)
activity_additions.category: permanent POP Fletching skilling pocket package
requirements: Player-owned port access and Scrimshaw Crafter unlocked (desert:scrimshaw-crafter / asgarnia Port Sarim workshop)
Eastern scroll pieces completed per scrimshaw recipe (voyage chain)
Ancient bones + completed Ports scroll for each craft
Fletching gates: 85 for entry skilling scrimshaws (e.g. log-splitting); higher for gem-finding / energy-gathering / tree-shaking / casket-salvaging tiers
unlocks: Wearable pocket skilling scrimshaws: log-splitting, rock-crushing, tree-shaking, gem-finding, whopper-baiting, casket-salvaging, memory-crushing, energy-gathering (plus superior variants)
Activated duration (standard 3 hours before dust; superior longer) with combine-to-extend charges
Ironman gather XP / resource-filter pocket tools without GE fills once scrolls + bones are self-sourced
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard: Port Sarim POP workshop / Scrimshaw Crafter facility under Equilibrium Arc mapping.
Desert optional: Menaphos / desert:player-owned-port hub framing and voyage economy pressure.
activity_additions.notes: Facility row desert:scrimshaw-crafter lists recipe names only — this package is the wearable skilling ladder planners checklist. Do not re-emit combat-only scrimshaw BiS lines here; elements and sacrifice are separate equipment rows.
activity_additions.league_treatment: facility. Voyage destinations may add optional region pressure only. · Invention skill unlock and workbench manufacture are global (not Asgarnia-locked). Guild machine-room scenery stays Asgarnia place geography only.

activity_additions.name: Scrimshaw of sacrifice (+ superior POP upgrade)
requirements: Inactive scrimshaw of sacrifice from Giant Mimic loot chests (current self-source; Motherlode Maw path removed 16 March 2026 Dailyscape Overhaul)
Optional superior: 250,000 Dungeoneering tokens unlock at Daemonheim Rewards to upgrade sacrifice/aggression/corruption scrimshaws at Scrimshaw Crafter
Superior craft: inactive base + 10 ancient bones at Scrimshaw Crafter (95 Fletching)
unlocks: While active: +50% combat XP on kills and +50% Slayer XP on-task (augmented-item XP excluded)
Trade: no primary loot drops (secondary drops such as charms, spirit gems, clues, ferocious rings, ushabti souls still apply; Wilderness shared loot and Looting perk items can still land)
Standard duration 1 hour active before dust; superior lasts 4 hours; same-type combine extends remaining time
Ironman AFK Slayer XP path when loot is not the goal (Wilderness PvME-style farms)
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard for Scrimshaw Crafter superior upgrade path + Ports ancient bones.
Forinthry optional: 250k DG token permanent unlock for superior craft line.
activity_additions.notes: Not a pure POP scroll craft like elements — base is Mimic. Still skilling-adjacent because ironman guides use it as a Slayer XP tool, not a combat BiS pocket. Sacrifice destroys bone drops so bonecrusher / DG prayer necklaces do not restore during its window.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Surface Asgarnia for superior craft facility. Mimic access is boss geography (not a hard single skilling region).

activity_additions.name: Binding contract (Ancient Summoning) craft + bind loop
activity_additions.category: permanent Ancient Summoning + Slayer bind infrastructure
requirements: Dagon Bye Archaeology mystery completed (Ancient Summoning unlock)
Summoning obelisk craft: 1 blue charm + pouch + 2 Blood of Orcus + 2 hellfire metal + 200 spirit shards per binding contract
Kill matching Slayer creature with free inventory space to bind pouch (charming imp can steal the free slot — plan inventory)
Summoning + Slayer level gates per familiar (e.g. waterfiend 50/50, gargoyle 75/75, abyssal demon 85/85)
unlocks: Ancient Summoning familiar pouches via combat bind (hellhound, waterfiend, blood reaver, gargoyle, abyssal demon, kal'gerion demon, ripper demon lines)
Skilling-relevant passives: waterfiend 5% gather duplicate storage (Mining/Fishing/WC/Div/Arch); gargoyle invisible +12 Mining damage
Account-state craft recipe after Dagon Bye — contracts also appear from ancient caskets but cannot bind until the mystery is done
region_pressure: Misthalin hard framing for Archaeology mystery unlock and Infernal Source material pressure (Blood of Orcus / hellfire metal).
Forinthry optional: kal'gerion bind DG level pressure.
Morytania / multi-region: abyssal and other bind monster farms.
activity_additions.notes: Combat-adjacent Summoning permanent, not pure BiS DPS. Waterfiend and gargoyle binds are the skilling planner edges; combat-only binds stay secondary.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Misthalin for mystery unlock framing. Bind-monster geography is multi-region by creature.

equipment_additions.name: Twisted bird skull necklace
requirements: 30 Prayer and 21 Dungeoneering (post-11-May-2026 remaster purchase gates)
6,500 Dungeoneering tokens from Marmaros (Daemonheim Rewards)
effects: Restores 50 prayer points when burying configured bones (all eligible tiers share 50 on this necklace)
With attuned ectoplasmator: 50 pp on absorbed ashes/ghosts in the necklace bands
Prayer bonus 3; pairs with bonecrusher for entry AFK prayer sustain
equipment_additions.notes: Lowest DG prayer necklace. cross-region:bonecrusher-necklace stack still points at demon horn as the end milestone — this row fills the missing individual ladder step.

equipment_additions.name: Split dragontooth necklace
requirements: 60 Prayer and 41 Dungeoneering (post-11-May-2026 remaster purchase gates)
15,500 Dungeoneering tokens from Marmaros (Daemonheim Rewards)
effects: Restores 50 pp (normal/bat/burnt bones) or 100 pp (big/baby dragon/jogre/wyvern and higher bone tiers on this necklace)
With attuned ectoplasmator: 50/100 pp ash and ghost bands (high-tier ashes/ghosts cap at 100, not 150)
Prayer bonus 4; mid-ladder AFK restore before demon horn
equipment_additions.notes: Mid DG prayer necklace. Prefer demon horn for 150 pp dragon/dinosaur bands.

equipment_additions.name: Demon horn necklace
requirements: 90 Prayer and 75 Dungeoneering (post-11-May-2026 remaster: DG gate reduced from 90 to 75)
35,000 Dungeoneering tokens from Marmaros (Daemonheim Rewards)
effects: Restores 50 / 100 / 150 prayer points by bone tier when burying or when bonecrusher auto-buries
With attuned ectoplasmator: 50 / 100 / 150 pp on ash and ghost absorption bands (including infernal/tortured/searing ashes and high-tier undead)
Prayer bonus 5; holy wrench (post-Pieces of Hate) adds +10% to necklace restore while worn or inventoried
equipment_additions.notes: Individual equipment row missing while cross-region:bonecrusher-necklace stack already first-class. Prefer this id for ownership tracking; keep the stack id for dual-item Prayer AFK packaging.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Forinthry. Pair with forinthry:bonecrusher and multi-region:toolbelt-bonecrusher-attach.

Does not stack First age outfit Prayer XP
